name: Proxmox Backup Server Detection Suite
name_zh: Proxmox Backup Server 偵測套組
summary: Failed backups, verification errors, full datastores, deleted backups, API token and permission changes, logins and undelivered notifications on Proxmox Backup Server, for which Wazuh has no rules.
summary_zh: Proxmox Backup Server 的備份失敗、驗證錯誤、datastore 空間不足、備份被刪除、API token 與權限變更、登入與通知送達失敗；Wazuh 內建完全沒有對應規則。
notes: Wazuh ships nothing for Proxmox Backup Server. Its daemons write to syslog, where a removable datastore left unplugged repeats one line every minute, and the parts that matter are in three files of their own: logins (api/auth.log), REST API requests (api/access.log) and the result of every finished task (tasks/archive). The pack decodes all four.

Task results, from the task archive: a backup that fails is level 7, and level 10 when the same backup group fails three times in a day (measured: one container failed three times a day for six weeks). A verification that finds corrupt or missing chunks is level 12; a verification that did not complete is level 6. Failed garbage collection, sync jobs and tape backups are level 10; failed prunes and tape restores level 7; any task that fails because the disk is full level 12. Warnings stay at level 0 except for garbage collection (level 7, usually missing chunks), sync, tape and verify (level 5) and prune (level 3).

Destructive and administrative tasks: a datastore removed is level 10; a backup group or namespace removed, a disk wiped or a tape encryption key removed level 8; a shell on the server opened from the web interface level 5; removable datastores mounted or unmounted, storage created and certificates ordered or renewed level 3.

REST API changes, from the access log (2xx answers only): API tokens created, changed or removed level 10; users, permissions, realms and two-factor settings level 8; datastore configuration level 8, and level 12 when a datastore is removed together with its data; backups deleted level 8, and level 12 for ten deletions from one address in five minutes; retention, protection and ownership of backups, remotes and sync jobs, certificates, notification settings and tape encryption keys level 6; network, DNS and time settings level 5. A change refused with 403 to an authenticated user or token is level 5. The agent group keeps only requests that change something (measured: 297,122 lines in three days, none of them a change).

Logins: a login is level 3, a failed password level 5, six from one address in five minutes level 10. The web interface renews its ticket every 15 minutes and each renewal is logged as a login, so an open browser tab is four level 3 alerts an hour. A request refused for an expired or missing ticket is level 2. A request refused for a wrong API token is level 5, and level 7 when one address keeps doing it: that is almost always a Proxmox VE node whose stored token no longer works, and its backups fail. These refusals are deliberately not in the authentication_failed group, so the built-in rule 40111 does not turn a misconfigured node into a brute-force alert.

Daemon messages: a notification that could not be delivered is level 7 (Proxmox Backup Server has no other way to report a failed job). A datastore that cannot be opened is level 10, at most once an hour. A datastore that is not mounted is logged once a minute while it has a schedule (measured: 40,978 lines in four weeks from one unplugged removable datastore); each line is recorded at level 2, and rule 131812 reports it at level 5 once it has lasted an hour, then at most once a day. Ten malformed connections to the API port from one address in two minutes are level 6. A copy of a backup task's error in syslog is level 3, because the task archive reports the same failure with the task type, the backup group and the user.

Datastore disk usage, from the df -P command in every Linux agent's default configuration (every 6 minutes): 90 to 97 per cent is level 10, 98 per cent and more level 12, each at most every 6 hours. Mount points under /mnt/datastore/ (disks formatted by Proxmox Backup Server, and removable datastores) are watched without configuration; list other mount points that hold a datastore in etc/lists/jt-pbs-datastore-mounts. The built-in rule 531 covers only /dev/ devices at 100 per cent and drops paths that contain usb; it never sees a ZFS dataset.

Not covered: the content of task logs (which chunk is corrupt, which snapshot failed) is one file per task and is not collected, so a rule says where to look rather than what broke. Certificate expiry is not logged by Proxmox Backup Server. Wazuh rules cannot be limited to an agent group, so the disk usage decoder adds two fields to the df -P lines of every agent; only the mount points above raise alerts.
Proxmox VE has a pack of its own, jt-proxmox; a failed backup is reported on both sides when both packs are installed (by the node that sent it and by the server that received it).
notes_zh: Wazuh 對 Proxmox Backup Server 沒有任何解碼器或規則。它的服務程式寫進 syslog（未掛載的卸除式 datastore 每分鐘重複一行），真正重要的內容在三個獨立檔案：登入（api/auth.log）、REST API 請求（api/access.log）、每個完成任務的結果（tasks/archive）。本套件四者都解碼。

任務結果取自任務封存檔：備份失敗為 level 7，同一個備份群組一天內失敗三次則為 level 10（實測：某個容器連續六週每天失敗三次）。驗證發現 chunk 損壞或遺失為 level 12，驗證未完成為 level 6。垃圾回收、同步工作、磁帶備份失敗為 level 10；prune 與磁帶還原失敗為 level 7；任何因磁碟已滿而失敗的任務為 level 12。警告維持 level 0，但垃圾回收（level 7，通常是 chunk 遺失）、同步、磁帶與驗證（level 5）、prune（level 3）除外。
破壞性與管理類任務：移除 datastore 為 level 10；移除備份群組或 namespace、抹除磁碟、移除磁帶加密金鑰為 level 8；從網頁介面開啟伺服器 shell 為 level 5；卸除式 datastore 掛載或卸載、建立儲存區、申請或更新憑證為 level 3。

REST API 變更取自存取記錄（只看 2xx 回應）：建立、修改或移除 API token 為 level 10；使用者、權限、realm 與雙因素設定為 level 8；datastore 設定為 level 8，連同資料一起移除 datastore 為 level 12；刪除備份為 level 8，同一位址五分鐘內刪除十次為 level 12；備份的保留、保護與擁有者，remote 與同步工作，憑證，通知設定，磁帶加密金鑰為 level 6；網路、DNS、時間設定為 level 5。已驗證的使用者或 token 被以 403 拒絕的變更為 level 5。agent 群組只保留會改變東西的請求（實測：三天 297,122 行，沒有一行是變更）。

登入：成功登入為 level 3，密碼錯誤為 level 5，同一位址五分鐘內六次為 level 10。網頁介面每 15 分鐘更新一次 ticket，每次更新都記成一次登入，所以開著的瀏覽器分頁每小時會產生四筆 level 3 告警。因 ticket 過期或缺少而被拒絕的請求為 level 2。因 API token 錯誤被拒絕為 level 5，同一位址持續發生則為 level 7：這幾乎都是某台 Proxmox VE 節點儲存的 token 已失效，該節點的備份會失敗。這類拒絕刻意不放進 authentication_failed 群組，避免內建規則 40111 把設定錯誤的節點當成暴力破解。

服務程式訊息：通知無法送達為 level 7（Proxmox Backup Server 沒有其他方式回報工作失敗）。無法開啟 datastore 為 level 10，每小時最多一次。datastore 有排程時，未掛載的狀態每分鐘記錄一次（實測：一個沒插上的卸除式 datastore 四週產生 40,978 行）；每行記錄為 level 2，持續一小時後規則 131812 以 level 5 回報，之後每天最多一次。同一位址兩分鐘內對 API 連接埠建立十次異常連線為 level 6。syslog 裡備份任務錯誤的副本為 level 3，因為任務封存檔會以任務類型、備份群組與使用者回報同一個失敗。

datastore 磁碟用量取自每個 Linux agent 預設設定中的 df -P 指令（每 6 分鐘一次）：90% 到 97% 為 level 10，98% 以上為 level 12，各自每 6 小時最多一次。/mnt/datastore/ 底下的掛載點（Proxmox Backup Server 格式化的磁碟與卸除式 datastore）不需設定即受監看；其他存放 datastore 的掛載點請列在 etc/lists/jt-pbs-datastore-mounts。內建規則 531 只看 /dev/ 裝置且達 100% 才觸發，並會丟掉路徑含 usb 的項目；它看不到 ZFS dataset。
未涵蓋：任務記錄的內容（哪個 chunk 損壞、哪個 snapshot 失敗）是每個任務一個檔案，不收集，所以規則只指出去哪裡看，不說明壞了什麼。Proxmox Backup Server 不記錄憑證到期。Wazuh 規則無法限定 agent 群組，因此磁碟用量解碼器會為每台 agent 的 df -P 記錄加上兩個欄位；只有上述掛載點會產生告警。
Proxmox VE 另有自己的套件 jt-proxmox；兩個套件都安裝時，備份失敗會在兩端各回報一次（送出備份的節點與接收備份的伺服器）。
author: Jason Tools

agent_group.name: pbs
agent_group.description: The Proxmox Backup Server logs outside syslog: logins, REST API changes and task results

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body: Install from this page, then use Reload Ruleset on the Rules tab. A cluster synchronises rule files but does not reload the workers. The pack declares the list etc/lists/jt-pbs-datastore-mounts in ossec.conf; on a cluster, declare it on the workers too.
setup.body_zh: 在本頁安裝後，到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集只同步規則檔、不會重載 worker。套件會在 ossec.conf 宣告清單 etc/lists/jt-pbs-datastore-mounts；叢集環境請在 worker 上也宣告。

setup.title: Assign the backup servers to the pbs group
setup.title_zh: 把備份伺服器加入 pbs 群組
setup.body: The group collects the login log, the REST API access log and the task archive under /var/log/proxmox-backup. On the agent it drops reads (GET, HEAD), the log upload and notes update that end every backup, login ticket requests and successful backup and restore sessions, which leaves a few lines a day. Daemon messages come from /var/log/syslog, which the agent reads already; on a server that logs only to journald, add a journald localfile to the agent's own configuration. Nothing changes on the backup server itself.
setup.body_zh: 群組會收集 /var/log/proxmox-backup 底下的登入記錄、REST API 存取記錄與任務封存檔。agent 端會丟掉讀取請求（GET、HEAD）、每次備份結尾的記錄上傳與 notes 更新、登入 ticket 請求，以及成功的備份與還原工作階段，每天只剩幾行。服務程式訊息來自 /var/log/syslog，agent 本來就有在讀；若伺服器只寫 journald，請在該 agent 自己的設定加上 journald 的 localfile。備份伺服器本身不需要任何變更。
setup.verify: Open a shell from the server's web interface (Administration, Shell) and close it. Expect rule 131857 (level 5) on the manager when the window closes.
setup.verify_zh: 從伺服器網頁介面（管理 → Shell）開啟 shell 後關閉。視窗關閉時 manager 端應出現規則 131857（level 5）。

setup.title: List datastore mount points outside /mnt/datastore
setup.title_zh: 列出 /mnt/datastore 以外的 datastore 掛載點
setup.body: For a datastore on a ZFS pool, an NFS share or any disk not formatted by Proxmox Backup Server, add the mount point that holds it (the last column of df -P on the server, not the datastore path below it), one line each, then reload the ruleset. Disk usage alerts start at 90 per cent.
setup.body_zh: datastore 若放在 ZFS pool、NFS 分享或任何不是由 Proxmox Backup Server 格式化的磁碟上，請把存放它的掛載點（伺服器上 df -P 的最後一欄，不是其下的 datastore 路徑）每行一個加入清單，再重新載入規則集。磁碟用量從 90% 開始告警。
setup.verify: Run df -P on the server and check the mount point is the one listed.
setup.verify_zh: 在伺服器上執行 df -P，確認掛載點與清單一致。

active_response.title: Block an address that keeps failing to log in
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖一再登入失敗的位址
active_response.body: Drops all traffic from the source address on the backup server, for 10 minutes, after six failed password logins in five minutes (rule 131805). It uses iptables or nftables on the server and blocks every port, including 8007, which Proxmox VE nodes use to send backups. Risks: an administrator who mistypes a password six times is locked out of the server for 10 minutes, with everyone behind the same NAT address; if the address is a Proxmox VE node (password logins from a node mean someone is using its shell, or the storage is configured with a password instead of an API token), that node's running and scheduled backups fail until the block expires. Wrong API tokens are a different rule (131804) and never trigger this. Put the management network and every Proxmox VE node address in the manager's white_list first.
active_response.body_zh: 五分鐘內密碼登入失敗六次（規則 131805）後，在備份伺服器上封鎖來源位址的所有流量 10 分鐘。它在伺服器上使用 iptables 或 nftables，會擋掉所有連接埠，包括 Proxmox VE 節點送備份用的 8007。風險：打錯密碼六次的管理者會被擋在伺服器外 10 分鐘，同一個 NAT 位址後的所有人也一樣；若該位址是 Proxmox VE 節點（節點發出密碼登入，代表有人在用它的 shell，或儲存區設定用的是密碼而非 API token），該節點進行中與排程中的備份會失敗直到封鎖解除。API token 錯誤是另一條規則（131804），不會觸發這個動作。請先把管理網段與所有 Proxmox VE 節點位址加入 manager 的 white_list。

active_response.title: Block an address that keeps probing the API port
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖一再探測 API 連接埠的位址
active_response.body: Drops all traffic from the source address on the backup server, for 10 minutes, after ten malformed connections (failed TLS handshakes, invalid HTTP methods) in two minutes (rule 131819). Risk: the site's own network scanner, inventory tool or a monitoring system that checks port 8007 with a plain TCP connection is blocked the same way, and a monitoring system then reports the server as down. Put those addresses in the manager's white_list first.
active_response.body_zh: 兩分鐘內出現十次異常連線（TLS 交握失敗、無效的 HTTP 方法）（規則 131819）後，在備份伺服器上封鎖來源位址的所有流量 10 分鐘。風險：站台自己的網路掃描器、資產盤點工具，或以單純 TCP 連線檢查 8007 連接埠的監控系統也會被同樣封鎖，監控系統接著會回報伺服器停機。請先把這些位址加入 manager 的 white_list。
